# NeuralSeek Central Brain

> Canonical knowledge base for NeuralSeek — product reference, client deployments, sales/positioning insights from calls, partnership materials, company story, and brand assets. Optimized for retrieval by AI agents. Markdown is the canonical format; original PDFs/DOCX live in `source/` subfolders.

## 🤖 AI agents fetching via raw URLs (claude.ai, etc.) — read this first

If your tool can only follow URLs that already appeared in a previously-fetched page, the relative paths in this index won't work for you. Use these absolute raw URLs as your entry point:

- **[RAW_INDEX.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/RAW_INDEX.md)** — every content file in the brain (79 files), grouped by folder, linked via absolute raw URLs.
- **[RAW_INDEX.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/RAW_INDEX.txt)** — same list as plain text, one URL per line, no markdown. Best for bulk ingestion.

The content links throughout the rest of this file have also been rewritten to absolute `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/...` URLs, so you can hop directly from any item below to the actual file.

---

## ⚠ Read this first if you're generating ANY NeuralSeek deliverable in ANY format

**The brand rules below apply to every output format — not just web/HTML.** Word docs (`.docx`), PowerPoint decks (`.pptx`), PDFs, HTML pages, slides, social cards, banners, images, emails, marketing collateral, even READMEs — all must follow these rules.

- [BRAND_RULES.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/BRAND_RULES.md): **CRITICAL — read before generating any deliverable of any kind.** TL;DR of the brand book + format-specific guidance (RULE 7) for PowerPoint, Word, PDF, HTML, images, emails, and markdown. Specifies the mandatory canvas background (rolling purple radial gradient), forbidden anti-patterns (NO dots, grids, mesh, noise, particles, stripes, circuit patterns, or any tiled pattern), the logo rule, fonts (Open Sans + JetBrains Mono with fallbacks), and color discipline.
- [Brand Guidelines — full markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/2026_images/neuralseek-brand-guidelines_2026.md): The complete v2.1 brand system. The first block of this file is the AI canvas background rule with copy-paste-ready CSS. **This `.md` is the preferred format for AI tools.** A rendered HTML version exists at `2026_images/neuralseek-brand-guidelines_2026.html` for humans.

**Inline copy of the canvas rule** (so it's findable from this index alone):
The body / page / slide background must be the **"rolling purple glow"** — a `#131316` (near-black) base with **five overlapping `#301E4C` (regal purple) radial-gradient ellipses at varied sizes, positions, and opacities** (plus `background-attachment: fixed`), applied wherever the format allows (CSS for HTML, gradient fill for PowerPoint, image-fill for Word cover pages, etc.). **Apply the exact CSS in [BRAND_RULES.md RULE 1](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/BRAND_RULES.md) verbatim — do not improvise the gradient values.** Anti-patterns absolutely forbidden in every format: dots, grids, mesh, noise, particles, stripes, circuit-board patterns, "AI hex" patterns, any tiled or repeated pattern. Format-specific guidance for `.docx`, `.pptx`, PDF, HTML, images, emails is in **RULE 7** of [BRAND_RULES.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/BRAND_RULES.md).

**Inline copy of the logo variant rule** (so it's findable from this index alone):
The brand canvas is dark by default, so use `2026_images/NeuralSeek Logos/color_logo_white_text.svg` (colored N + white text) on any non-white background. Only switch to `neuralseek__colored_logo_and_name.png` (colored N + colored text) when the background is genuinely white. For mark-only placements use `neuralseek_colored_just_logo.png`; for monochrome contexts use `neuralseek_all_white_logo_and_name.png`. Full variant table in **RULE 2** of [BRAND_RULES.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/BRAND_RULES.md).

---

NeuralSeek is an LLM-agnostic orchestration platform that serves as the governance and control layer between frontend AI experiences (ChatGPT-style UIs, Copilot, custom apps, Slack) and backend LLMs (OpenAI Enterprise, Azure GPT-4.5, Claude, Gemini, and others). It enforces guardrails, policy, semantic scoring, and per-tenant isolation — making AI safe enough for regulated enterprises (healthcare, financial services, government).

## Product features and reference docs

- [AI Tuning & Guardrails](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Features/all-ai-tuning-and-guardrails.md): Complete Configure-tab reference. Part 1 covers AI tuning (data connection, document ranking, answer generation). Part 2 covers guardrails for governing user input and model output.
- [Platform-Level AI Ops Settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Features/platform-level-ai-ops-settings.md): Every platform-wide Configure-tab control — timeouts, context, language, caching, governance, prompt engineering, secrets. Distinct from per-call API parameters.
- [LLM API-Level Tuning](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Features/llm-api-level-tuning.md): How the "Send To LLM" node controls prompts, generation parameters, caching, and message overrides on a per-call basis inside mAIstro flows.
- [NeuralSeek Governance Framework](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Features/neuralseek-governance.md): Enterprise AI governance — real-time safety, compliance, integrity. Prompt injection protection, PII redaction, content filtering, audit.
- [Detailed RFP Response](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Features/detailed-rfp-response.md): NeuralSeek's response to a detailed RFP. Covers LLM-agnostic orchestration, integrations (OpenAI Enterprise, Azure GPT-4.5, Claude, Gemini), policy enforcement, semantic scoring, token tracking, frontend flexibility.
- [NeuralSeek Documentation Knowledge Base](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Features/NeuralSeek_Documentation_KB.md): Aggregated documentation knowledge base.
- [118 AI Guardrails Listing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Features/neuralseek_118_ai_guardrails_listing.md): Full catalog of NeuralSeek's 118 AI guardrails.
- [mAIstro Governance Analysis](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Features/maistro_governance_analysis.md): Analysis of governance controls in mAIstro (the multi-agent orchestration layer).
- [Seek Governance Analysis](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Features/seek_governance_analysis.md): Analysis of governance controls in NeuralSeek Seek (the retrieval layer).
- [NeuralWorks — Governed AI Notetaker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Features/neuralworks-ai-notetaker.md): NeuralSeek's modular AI notetaker that joins Microsoft Teams / Zoom / Google Meet, transcribes inside the customer boundary, and routes every conversation to governed action across CRM, ticketing, and inbox through NeuralSeek mAIstro agent flows. Tagline: *"Take notes under policy."* Differentiates from Gong / Fireflies / Fathom / Zoom AI / Microsoft Copilot via on-prem/VPC/air-gapped deployment, LLM-agnostic 2-click model swap, semantic-lineage summary scoring, 4-layer PII/PHI redaction before storage, attribution protection against fabricated quotes, full replay audit, and 8 ship-ready agents (Meeting Summary Email, CRM Update, Action Items → Slack, Jira Task Creator, HubSpot Contact Update, Weekly Report, Transcript Archive, Onboarding Follow-Up). Use when prompted about: AI notetakers for regulated industries, CISO objections to commodity meeting recorders, secure meeting transcription, Teams/Zoom/Meet integrations under HIPAA/SOC 2/FedRAMP, or differentiating against Otter/Gong/Fireflies for banking/healthcare/government buyers.

## ROI, TCO, and competitive math — *use whenever a prompt asks about cost, savings, time-to-production, build-vs-buy, or guardrail volume*

These are the defensible, source-cited numbers. Pull from here for any pricing, ROI, payback, deployment-speed, or competitive-comparison conversation — instead of inventing figures or pulling them from the broader corpus.

- [ROI Analysis — Index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/ROI_Analysis/00-INDEX.md): Map of when to use each ROI file, with headline numbers and usage guardrails. **Read this first if the prompt touches cost, savings, or competitive math.**
- [Days to MVP](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/ROI_Analysis/A-days-to-mvp.md): Time-to-production by named customer (Children's Health 2 weeks, Great Day Improvements 10, NatWest 12, Itochu 13, Clip 15). Use for "how fast does NeuralSeek ship?", deployment-speed framing, "weeks not quarters" headlines.
- [Itochu Analyst ROI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/ROI_Analysis/B-itochu-analyst-roi.md): Defensible $-saved math on 500 analysts going from 3 weeks to 13 minutes per research deliverable. ~$10.5M/yr at conservative assumptions. Use for analyst-productivity ROI, knowledge-worker time savings, the Itochu economics story. Inputs sourced from BLS, Glassdoor, Robert Half.
- [Itochu Bake-off vs. "N8N + 4 security tools"](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/ROI_Analysis/C-itochu-bakeoff-vs-stack.md): Tony Chang's on-record quote, fully costed. $2.07M/yr to assemble the equivalent stack vs. $240K/yr NeuralSeek — ~$1.83M/yr saved before any productivity gain. Also includes AlphaSense ($5–7.5M/yr) and S&P Capital IQ ($2.5–6M/yr) replacement math. Use vs. N8N, point-tool stacks, "we'll integrate it ourselves" objections.
- [Build-vs-Buy TCO (3-year, 5 use cases)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/ROI_Analysis/D-build-vs-buy-tco.md): Three paths to 5 production AI use cases costed over 3 years: build-it-yourself ($8.1M), best-of-breed vendor stack ($6.3M), NeuralSeek ($1.2M). Anchored to Children's Health's actual 5-use-case scope. Use for build-vs-buy decisions, "we have an internal AI team" objection, CFO TCO conversations.
- [Guardrails in Action (illustrative)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/ROI_Analysis/E-guardrails-in-action.md): Modeled monthly guardrail-trigger volumes for Itochu (~5K semantic-grounding interventions, ~10K PII redactions) and Children's Health (~2K PHI redactions, ~500 policy-violation deflections). **Illustrative model, not customer telemetry — label as such in any external use and confirm with the customer before attribution.**

## Talk tracks — *use whenever a prompt asks for a quote, soundbite, opener, persona-specific pitch line, LinkedIn lead, or a way to explain something to a specific audience*

Nineteen formally-curated, single-thesis talk tracks. Each follows the same shape: **Punchline** (the line itself, ready to lift verbatim), **Why this lands** (the cognitive mechanism), **NeuralSeek tie-in** (the product bridge), **Use** (the audience and context). **Different from** the call-derived patterns in `Knowledge from Calls/06-sales-talk-tracks.md` and `12-punch-line-talk-tracks.md` — these Talk Tracks are validated against a top-tier venture firm's published agentic-AI thesis and designed to be lifted directly into pitches, posts, and decks.

- [Talk Tracks — Index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Talk%20Tracks/00-INDEX.md): By-category map (mental models / why-now / market position / explainers / POV) + audience-to-track selection guide (CFO, CISO, CTO, procurement, investors, channel, technical). **Read this first to pick the right talk track for the prompt.**

**Mental models** (the cleanest analogies):
- [TT-01 Calculator → Strategist](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Talk%20Tracks/TT-01-from-calculator-to-strategist.md): The cleanest mental model — chatbot=calculator, agent=strategist. Opener with non-technical CFOs / board members / new prospects.
- [TT-02 The Loop is the Agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Talk%20Tracks/TT-02-the-loop-is-the-agent.md): ReAct loop demystified — perceive, plan, act, observe, repeat. Use for whiteboarding "what even is an AI agent?"

**Why now / macro context**:
- [TT-03 Every major computing paradigm](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Talk%20Tracks/TT-03-every-major-computing-paradigm.md): Reframes AI from "fad?" to "20-year cycle?" — investor-grade framing. Conference keynote opener, LinkedIn lead.
- [TT-04 Inference costs fell ~1000× in 3 years](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Talk%20Tracks/TT-04-why-now-inference-costs-fell.md): The "why now" answer with numbers, not vibes ($60/M → pennies/M tokens). Pair with any "AI is finally ready for enterprise" pitch.
- [TT-05 Agents proliferate per workflow, not per user](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Talk%20Tracks/TT-05-agents-proliferate-per-workflow.md): Token-cost-scale reframing — pair with NeuralSeek's 4-layer token throttling pitch. CFO / CTO budget conversations.
- [TT-06 Always-on attack surface](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Talk%20Tracks/TT-06-always-on-attack-surface.md): M365 Copilot EchoLeak exploit named with specifics. Every CISO conversation, every healthcare / financial-services discovery call.

**Where NeuralSeek sits in the market**:
- [TT-07 As models commoditize, advantage shifts to coordinators](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Talk%20Tracks/TT-07-as-models-commoditize.md): Third-party validation of NeuralSeek's LLM-agnostic thesis. The single most important positioning point. Every investor / partnership conversation.
- [TT-08 Whoever owns the workflow owns the value](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Talk%20Tracks/TT-08-whoever-owns-the-workflow.md): Direct restatement of the NeuralSeek value prop, written by a third party. Maps 1:1 to category routing + dynamic LLM selection + governance + replay + iteration. THE opener slide.
- [TT-09 The 5-Layer Agent Stack](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Talk%20Tracks/TT-09-the-5-layer-agent-stack.md): Table of Intelligence / Action / Governance / Orchestration / Economics — competitors live in one layer, NeuralSeek touches all five. Sales kit one-pager, investor deck.
- [TT-10 Salesforce moved to consumption pricing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Talk%20Tracks/TT-10-salesforce-consumption-pricing.md): April 15, 2026 Salesforce Headless 360 announcement names the world's largest enterprise SaaS doing what NeuralSeek already does. Salesforce-aware buyers, channel / VAR conversations.
- [TT-11 The OpenClaw parallel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Talk%20Tracks/TT-11-open-source-coding-layer-parallel.md): "OpenClaw is the agent harness for coding. NeuralSeek is the agent harness for regulated enterprise workflows." Technical buyers familiar with Claude Code / Cursor.

**Explaining NeuralSeek to non-technical people**:
- [TT-12 Three Pillars of Agentic Intelligence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Talk%20Tracks/TT-12-three-pillars-of-agentic-intelligence.md): Reasoning (MoE) + Memory (MLA) + Knowledge (RAG) visualized as a Greek temple. Beautiful brain analogy. Maps to NeuralSeek's category routing. Whiteboard explanation.
- [TT-13 Seek node = agent harness, compressed](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Talk%20Tracks/TT-13-seek-node-agent-harness-compressed.md): One NTL line ≈ 6,000 lines of TypeScript that Anthropic / OpenAI hand-build. Technical buyer demo, especially after Claude Code exposure.
- [TT-14 AI engineer in a box](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Talk%20Tracks/TT-14-ai-engineer-in-a-box.md): Existing pitch now validated by economics — a $20 sub generates $163 of compute; even Anthropic loses money. Buy-vs-build conversations.
- [TT-19 NeuralSeek = Docker for AI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Talk%20Tracks/TT-19-docker-for-ai.md): "Docker lets you run the same app on any machine without it breaking — NeuralSeek does that for custom AI." Bundles model + your data + guardrails into one portable unit that runs the same across AWS / Azure / IBM Cloud / on-prem / hybrid. Two registers: a "kitchen / cake recipe" version for non-technical listeners, and a Docker-concept-to-NeuralSeek mapping table for technical / enterprise buyers. Enterprise close: no vendor lock-in (swap the LLM with no rebuild). First-conversation / mixed-room explainer.

**The compelling POV — why NeuralSeek's architecture is correct**:
- [TT-15 Governance is a property of the architecture, not the model](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Talk%20Tracks/TT-15-governance-is-architecture.md): **THE watershed quote.** Top-tier VC firm validates NeuralSeek's 3-year-old architectural thesis. Every other AI safety story puts boundaries in the model; NeuralSeek puts them in the architecture. CISO conversations, board presentations, regulatory-defense narratives.
- [TT-16 Even Anthropic can't get governance right](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Talk%20Tracks/TT-16-even-anthropic-cant-get-governance-right.md): March 2026 Claude Code source-code leak (512K lines), Amazon Q production-deletion outages (13-hour AWS China outage, 120K lost orders), 250K failed API calls/day at Anthropic. Three of the most sophisticated AI orgs publicly failing at exactly what NeuralSeek's 118 guardrails were built to prevent. Highest-leverage CISO / CTO talk track available.
- [TT-17 Price per completed task, not cost per token](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Talk%20Tracks/TT-17-price-per-completed-task.md): Independent analysis names per-token pricing as the wrong metric. NeuralSeek's containerized flat-fee model is now the architecturally-correct answer. Pricing / TCO conversations, procurement objections.
- [TT-18 Companies that act now will lead](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Talk%20Tracks/TT-18-companies-that-act-now.md): The urgency message — the next 12 months are when category leadership gets decided. Closing slide of every pitch deck.

## Marketing Alignment Pack — *use whenever a prompt asks for a pitch deck, investor narrative, board briefing, CISO conversation, side-by-side competitive table, or third-party-validated positioning*

Drop-in, deck-ready content built almost entirely from a **top-tier Silicon Valley venture firm's May 2026 "A Primer on AI Agents"** deck. Use these when the goal is to make architectural / economic / governance claims **with external validation** rather than NeuralSeek's own assertions. Companion folder to `ROI_Analysis/` (which holds the rest of the same pack — A through E — for cost/savings math).

- [Marketing Alignment Pack — Index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Marketing%20Alignment%20Pack/00-INDEX.md): Pack relationships (F/G/H here, A–E in ROI_Analysis), tight coupling with Talk Tracks (TT-03/04/05/06/07/08/09/15/16/17), and assembly recipes for investor pitch / CISO meeting / board briefing / conference keynote / cold outreach / RFP. **Read this first to pick the right combination for the prompt.**
- [F — VC Firm Agrees (six-claim side-by-side)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Marketing%20Alignment%20Pack/F-vc-firm-agrees-onepager.md): Six structural claims from the VC deck, each paired with the NeuralSeek capability that already delivers it. Models commoditize → orchestration accrues / workflow is control point / 5-layer stack / governance is architecture / Anthropic-Amazon-Microsoft failures / price-per-task. Each row = one clean deck slide. Use for investor pitches, partnership conversations, third-party-validation segments.
- [G — Why Now (3-slide segment)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Marketing%20Alignment%20Pack/G-why-now-segment.md): Drop-in 3-slide deck segment. Slide 1: every paradigm looked like a feature first. Slide 2: 1000× inference-cost drop. Slide 3: agent proliferation 139%/524% CAGR (IDC + Goldman). Optional NeuralSeek closer slide. Use for any deck needing urgency without vendor-pitch tone, 10-min board briefings, conference openers, website hero anchor.
- [H — CTO/CISO Talk Tracks (May 2026 Refresh)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Marketing%20Alignment%20Pack/H-ciso-talk-track-refresh.md): **3 new selling angles** (4, 5, 6) extending the 3 originals in `Knowledge from Calls/13-cto-ciso-selling-angles.md`. Each is a full talk-track package — buyer mental state, talk track, key hooks, why-it-lands, deployment moments. Ends with a 6-angle playbook table. Angle 4 (always-on attack surface) + Angle 5 (governance is architecture) + Angle 6 (even Anthropic can't get this right). Use for every CISO discovery call, RFP / security-questionnaire responses (lift Angle 5's four-property list verbatim), CISO-targeted LinkedIn posts timed to industry incidents.

## Knowledge from sales and discovery calls

These are distilled insights extracted from six recent calls — sales/training, discovery/demos, partnership conversations, and brand interviews. The most current view of how NeuralSeek positions, sells, and handles objections.

- [Index of Knowledge from Calls](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Knowledge%20from%20Calls/00-INDEX.md): Master index — describes each source call and links every distilled file.
- [Strategic Positioning](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Knowledge%20from%20Calls/01-strategic-positioning.md): How Lawrence frames NeuralSeek in the market.
- [Powerful Quotes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Knowledge%20from%20Calls/02-powerful-quotes.md): High-impact verbatim quotes ready to reuse.
- [Objection Handling](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Knowledge%20from%20Calls/03-objection-handling.md): Common objections and Lawrence's responses.

## Partnerships

- [NeuralSeek + IBM Fusion Solution Brief](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/NeuralSeek%20Knowledge/Partnerships/ibm-fusion-ns-solution-brief.md): Joint brief on secure, no-code AI for regulated enterprises (HIPAA, PCI-DSS, FINRA, GDPR, CJIS). Addresses data sovereignty and access control gaps that public-cloud LLMs cannot meet.

Serves financial services, healthcare, government.

## Brand and image assets

The `2026_images/` directory holds 266+ image files for use in branded content, presentations, and articles. Organized by topic:

- `2026_images/NeuralSeek Logos/` — NeuralSeek brand marks.
- `2026_images/Client Logos (colored)/` — Logos of clients (colored versions).
- `2026_images/whited_logos/` — White / monochrome client logos.
- `2026_images/Companies Logos/` — Partner and ecosystem company logos.
- `2026_images/Demo Logos/` — Logos used in demo materials.
- `2026_images/LLM Logos/` — Logos of LLM providers (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, etc.).
- `2026_images/3rd Party Data Sources/` — Logos of integrated data sources.
- `2026_images/People photos/` — Headshots of team and execs.
- `2026_images/CISO_icons/` — Iconography for CISO-themed content.
- `2026_images/Seek Governance/` — Visuals for NeuralSeek's governance story.
- `2026_images/mAIstro Governance/` — Visuals for mAIstro's governance story.
- `2026_images/Guardrails Images/` — Visuals for the guardrails story.
- `2026_images/Enterprise Apps/` — App / product screenshots and renders.
- `2026_images/Custom Client Apps/` — Screenshots of custom-built client deployments.
- `2026_images/HealthCareAgentStack/` — Visuals for the healthcare agent stack.
- `2026_images/IBM Fusion + NeuralSeek/` — Co-branded IBM Fusion visuals.
- `2026_images/nodes/` — mAIstro node icons.
- [Brand Guidelines (full markdown)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/2026_images/neuralseek-brand-guidelines_2026.md): NeuralSeek 2026 brand system v2.1 — logo, color, typography, voice, taglines, AND the mandatory canvas background rule at the top of the file. **Preferred format for AI tools.** See also [BRAND_RULES.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/BRAND_RULES.md) at the repo root for the AI-critical TL;DR.
- [Brand Guidelines (HTML — visual)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CerebralBlue-LOV/neuralseek-brain/main/2026_images/neuralseek-brand-guidelines_2026.html): Rendered version for humans. Contains the same AI canvas rule in-body so re-converting via pandoc preserves it.

## Optional / source files

Original DOCX, PDF, and PPTX files are preserved under `source/` subfolders inside each topic directory. Markdown is canonical for retrieval; the originals are kept for sending to humans (decks, formal documents) or as fallback if conversion was lossy.
